name: Puerto Rican broad-winged hawk
desc: A rare forest hawk found in El Yunque's tabonuco forest. Raptors including hawks are listed among natural predators of the parrot.
about: The Puerto Rican broad-winged hawk is an endangered subspecies of the broad-winged hawk (B. platypterus). It is a small hawk that occurs in Puerto Rico, inhabiting the Toro Negro State Forest.
